# Synthetic test images

Generated by `scripts/make-fixtures.swift` using macOS drawing and Image I/O.
All text, contact details and graphics are synthetic and contain no user data.
These fixtures are covered by the repository's MIT license.

From the repository root:

```sh
swift scripts/make-fixtures.swift crates/candy-macos/tests/fixtures
```

`sample.*` share the same content across PNG, JPEG, HEIC and AVIF.
`orientation6.jpg` exercises EXIF rotation. Tests create a temporary WebP
from the PNG to cover WebP encoding and decoding.
